M62=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in rawm.strip().split("\n")])
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}; enc=lambda s: np.array([idx.get(c,22) for c in s])
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2);n,m=len(s1),len(s2);S=M62[np.ix_(e1,e2)];NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    PM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);PX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);PY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mi1=M[i-1];Xi1=X[i-1];Yi1=Y[i-1];Mi=M[i];Xi=X[i];Yi=Y[i];Si=S[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(Mi1[j-1],Xi1[j-1],Yi1[j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(c));Mi[j]=c[k]+Si[j-1];PM[i,j]=k
            c=(Mi1[j]+go,Xi1[j]+ge,Yi1[j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));Xi[j]=c[k];PX[i,j]=k
            c=(Mi[j-1]+go,Xi[j-1]+go,Yi[j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Yi[j]=c[k];PY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]]));P=[PM,PX,PY];pr=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: pr.append((i,j));ns=P[0][i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: ns=P[1][i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: ns=P[2][i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j==0: break
    return pr[::-1]

CON=[405,406,407,409,410,411,413,414,417,418,421,422,424,425,426,428,429,432,433,436,439,440,443,447,450,451,453,454,457,458,460,461,463,464,465,467,468,471,474,475,478,479,481,482,484,485,488,489,491,492,494,495,496,498,499,502,503]

ce="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q17595.fasta",timeout=120).text.split("\n")[1:])
crOff=len(cr)-150; ceOff=len(ce)-160
pr=nw(cr[crOff:],ce[ceOff:])
cr2ce={a+crOff:b+ceOff for a,b in pr}
ident=sum(1 for a,b in pr if cr[a+crOff-1]==ce[b+ceOff-1])
print(f"Cr IFT54 (len {len(cr)}) C-term150 vs DYF-11 (len {len(ce)}) C-term160: {len(pr)} aligned pairs, {ident} identical ({100*ident/len(pr):.1f}%)")
mapped=[(r,cr[r-1],cr2ce.get(r)) for r in CON]
nmap=sum(1 for _,_,q in mapped if q)
print(f"{nmap}/{len(CON)} IFT20-contacting Cr residues map onto a DYF-11 residue\n")
print(" ".join(f"{a}{r}>{ce[q-1]}{q}" for r,a,q in mapped if q))
print("\nidentical at the mapped position:",sum(1 for r,a,q in mapped if q and ce[q-1]==a),"/",nmap)

js=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=xref:pfam-PF17749&fields=accession,organism_name,sequence,length&format=json&size=200",timeout=180).json()["results"]
byorg={}
for r in js:
    o=r["organism"]["scientificName"]
    if o not in byorg and 350<r["sequence"]["length"]<900: byorg[o]=(r["primaryAccession"],r["sequence"]["value"])
WANT=["Homo sapiens","Mus musculus","Danio rerio","Xenopus tropicalis","Drosophila melanogaster",
 "Chlamydomonas reinhardtii","Tetrahymena thermophila","Trypanosoma brucei","Ciona intestinalis","Gallus gallus",
 "Caenorhabditis briggsae","Caenorhabditis remanei","Strongylocentrotus purpuratus","Bos taurus","Rattus norvegicus"]
orth=[(o,)+byorg[o] for o in WANT if o in byorg]
orth+=[(o,)+v for o,v in byorg.items() if o not in WANT][:max(0,16-len(orth))]
print("\northologs used:",len(orth))
print([o for o,_,_ in orth])
tgt=[q for _,_,q in mapped if q]; cnt={q:0 for q in tgt}; tot=0
for o,ac,sq in orth:
    off=max(0,len(sq)-160)
    mm={b+ceOff:a+off for a,b in nw(sq[off:],ce[ceOff:])}
    tot+=1
    for q in tgt:
        i=mm.get(q)
        if i and sq[i-1]==ce[q-1]: cnt[q]+=1
pct={q:100*cnt[q]/tot for q in tgt}
hi=[q for q in tgt if pct[q]>=50]
print(f"\n{len(hi)}/{len(tgt)} interface positions identical to the DYF-11 residue in >=50% of {tot} orthologs")
print("  ".join(f"{ce[q-1]}{q}:{pct[q]:.0f}"for q in tgt))
print("\nspacing between consecutive contacting Cr residues:",dict(sorted(collections.Counter(np.diff(CON).tolist()).items())))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.2))
xs=list(range(len(tgt)))
ax.bar(xs,[pct[q] for q in tgt],color=["#2b6cb0" if pct[q]>=50 else "#a0aec0" for q in tgt])
ax.set_xticks(xs); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{ce[q-1]}{q}" for q in tgt],rotation=90,fontsize=6.5)
ax.axhline(50,color="#cbd5e0",ls="--",lw=.8)
ax.set_ylabel(f"identical in % of {tot} IFT54 orthologs")
ax.set_xlabel("DYF-11 residue aligned to a Chlamydomonas IFT54 residue that contacts IFT20 in 8RUY")
ax.set_title("IFT20-contacting coiled-coil interface of IFT54 mapped onto DYF-11, scored for cross-species identity",fontsize=10)
